title: The maximum number of mutually unbiased bases in dimension six
summary: We prove that the maximum number of mutually unbiased orthonormal bases in ℂ 6 is three, resolving Zauner's dimension-six MUB conjecture. The upper bound is computer-assisted: under the stated binary64 arithmetic and compiler conditions, a complete execution of the documented verification pipeline excludes four arbitrary complex bases.
family_title: Exactly three mutually unbiased bases in dimension six

review.reason: Proves that three is the maximum number of mutually unbiased bases in dimension six.
